risks.summary: Async correctness: jobs lost/duplicated/stuck on machine sleep.
risks.mitigation: Durable SQLite leases with expiry; reclaimed on restart. Verified incl. real SIGKILL mid-lease (VS-DURABLE).

risks.summary: Silent prompt truncation on the local model.
risks.mitigation: num_ctx set per call; prompt_eval_count asserted; TruncationError on overflow; verified against real Ollama (VS-CTX). Confirmed by Gen-0 probe.

risks.summary: Fallback launders a prompt defect into an availability event.
risks.mitigation: Availability-vs-content classification; content failures do not fall through; diagnosis attributes correctly (VS-TRACE, BDD-013).

risks.mitigation: Post-redaction payload captured; deep redact; secret-leak scan over the store. OQ-3 confirms boundary.

Metrics computed from the same attempts rows; reconciliation asserted (BDD-016).
Call-over-job priority + fairness floor with a disabled-floor control test. Floor NUMBER is OQ-4 (default every 4th dispatch).

risks.mitigation: Deferred. Flag for a retention policy decision.
